notes: Exclusion: excluded, not needs_review. The pages state the core purpose unambiguously: 'All-in-One Affiliate Management Software for SaaS' and 'an affiliate and referral management platform that helps SaaS companies launch and scale affiliate programs'; commissions, affiliate payouts, affiliate portal and Affiliate Finder are the whole product (core affiliate program management and payouts, CLAUDE.md §3), not an incidental referral feature. Pricing: the snapshot holds both /pricing and /pricing-old with byte-identical text; quotes cite /pricing and the plans are not duplicated. Monthly and annual ('2 months free') amounts are both displayed: Starter $49/mo or $490/yr, Growth $99/mo or $990/yr, Enterprise $149+/mo or $1,490+/yr. Enterprise is tiered by affiliate-attributed revenue ('Enterprise is tiered. Higher usage moves to a higher tier'); $149/$1,490 are entry-tier starting prices, so 'usage' could also be argued for that plan. Managed Payouts (3% processing fee) and Affiliate Finder credits are add-ons/usage fees, not plans. 'Trusted by 3,000+ teams', 'Rated #1 for Ease of Setup on G2' and testimonial revenue figures are company-stated or third-party claims, not payment proof. The founded year is not stated ('built on 10 years of expertise' is not a founding date); 'Rewardful Inc.' does not state a country. The 'Rewardful Skill for Claude' promo block is marketing addressed to human visitors, not an instruction to the extractor, so no forbidden text was added.
